newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sabena shareholders vote to continue operations.
newsitem.headline: Sabena shareholders vote to continue operations.

text.p: Shareholders of loss-making Belgian airline Sabena SA voted unanimously in favour of continuing operations at an extraordinary general meeting on Thursday, Sabena said in a statement.
Shareholders also unanimously approved the 1996 accounts of the carrier which made a consolidated loss after provisions of 8.87 billion Belgian francs ($250 million), Sabena said.

Chairman Valere Croes told shareholders that Sabena was on track for returning to profitability by 1998 with an increase of first-quarter traffic of 15 percent and rise in the average seat occupancy rate by three percentage points to 57 percent.
"Costs have remained under control but income is still suffering from very strong competition between European airlines," the statement said.
Sabena is 49.5 percent owned by Swissair, which said earlier this month it would fully write down the value of its Sabena stake in 1996 accounts.
